name: Iruma Sumire
source:
She is a servant girl who has been by the protagonist's side since she was a young child.
Although she now places great importance on the relationship between the main character and her servants, in the past they were just ordinary friends, and she sometimes treats him in a friendly manner due to the remnants of that relationship.
Although she is deeply loyal to the protagonist, she is troubled only by his excessive collection of sex-toys.
She is the epitome of a maid who is kind and considerate to everyone, always standing up for others and doing her job well.
She is a pushover and cannot refuse requests, so she is assigned to supervise the onahole girls.
Because of her personality, she is always caught up in the commotion caused by the onahole girls and is always badly hurt.
She is a quiet person by nature, but for the sake of the main character, she sometimes decides to take bold actions.

Deep down, she has always had feelings for the protagonist, but because she wants him to be happy more than anyone else, she keeps her feelings hidden because of the difference in their status.
She envies the onahole girls who make strong approaches to the protagonist, but she supports them for the sake of the protagonist's happiness, a girl who seems to be dressed in a maid's outfit of health.
